newsitem.title: CHINA: Huaneng in $538 mln eastern China power plant deal.
newsitem.headline: Huaneng in $538 mln eastern China power plant deal.

text.p: China's Huaneng Group Corp has signed an agreement with several Chinese companies to build a 4.47 billion yuan ($538 million) power plant in eastern Jiangsu province, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.

Huaneng Group, which includes the New York-listed Huaneng International Power Co, would join with investment partners from Jiangsu province and Suzhou city to build the 600 megawatt coal-fired plant, the agency said.
It gave no details of the scale of each partner's investment in the plant, which would be built in Taicang city near Suzhou and would supply electricity to the Suzhou Industrial Park.
A joint-venture company, the Suzhou Industrial Park Huaneng Power Plant Company Ltd, had been set up by the investors to operate the power plant, it said.
The Jiangsu Provincial Power Corp would build all the plant's transmission and transformation facilities and the project was scheduled to begin in early 1997, it said without giving further details.
